title: EA-6B Defensive Tactics Instructor (DEFTACTI) Qualification (I) (Col to 2ndLt) NMOS (7543, 7588, 8042), DC AVN
raw_text:
24. MOS 7538, EA-6B Defensive Tactics Instructor (DEFTACTI) Qualification
(I) (Col to 2ndLt) NMOS (7543, 7588, 8042), DC AVN

    a. Summary. THIS IS AN OBSOLETE MOS, NO LONGER IN USE IN THE TABLE OF
ORGANIZATION OF THE MARINE CORPS. THIS MOS IS MAINTAINED IN THE MOS MANUAL
BECAUSE IT APPEARS IN THE RECORDS OF MARINES STILL ON ACTIVE DUTY. DEFTACI
qualified personnel are trained on tactical employment of the EA-6B in air
threat environments. This MOS will be assigned only as a Necessary MOS to
qualified aviation personnel.

       b.   Prerequisites.    Be qualified in defensive tactics (DEFTAC).

    c. Requirements.         Complete defensive tactics (DEFTAC) work ups per the
EA-6B T&R.

       d.   Duties.   Instruct and qualify students in DEFTAC in the EA-6B.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Teachers and Instructors, All Other 25-3099.

       f.   Related Military Skill.    None.
